Storage

Source: R/order.R
roar_optimize.Rd

roar_optimize() returns a copy of x that uses run-length containers where they are smaller and holds no spare capacity; roar() does this by default. roar_stats() describes how x is stored: for each kind of CRoaring container, how many there are, how many values they hold and how many bytes they use. roar_size() is the number of bytes the portable serialised form of x takes.

Usage

roar_optimize(x)

roar_stats(x)

roar_size(x)

Arguments

x

A bitmap.

Value

roar_optimize() a bitmap, roar_stats() a data frame with columns kind, containers, values and bytes, roar_size() a single double.

Examples

x <- roar(c(1:10, 100000:200000), optimize = FALSE)
roar_stats(x)
#>     kind containers values bytes
#> 1  array          2   3403  6806
#> 2 bitset          2  96608 16384
#> 3    run          0      0     0
roar_stats(roar_optimize(x))
#>     kind containers values bytes
#> 1  array          0      0     0
#> 2 bitset          0      0     0
#> 3    run          4 100011    24
roar_size(x)
#> [1] 23230
